scheme_name: West Bengal Incentive Scheme for Approved Industrial Park (SAIP) for MSMEs: Incentive for Common Effluent Treatment Plant (CETP)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a private‑sector entity or an existing/operational industrial park.
A minimum of 5 acres of legally owned land (by direct purchase or lease from the State Government) is required.
The Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) must be registered under the Companies Act, Societies Registration Act, Partnership Act or LLP Act.
Park area should be expanded to at least 5 acres in out‑lying districts and at least 2 acres in Kolkata and Howrah.
All individual units must have obtained necessary clearances for land conversion, fire licence, environmental compliance, building plan, etc.
The SPV must obtain prior approval justifying the feasibility and requirement for the CETP in the AIP.
The SPV must obtain consent from WBSIDCL before installing the CETP concerning the accredited vendor, selected technology and cost estimate.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of ₹5,00,000 per acre for installation of a Common Effluent Treatment Plant (CETP).
documents_required: Signature and seal (JPG/PNG format, maximum 2 MB)
